task: Core #1186 F6-U03n: 2-tenant Alap/Pro isolated PG17 JWT-role RLS rehearsal with fail-closed real-provider boundary

assuranceCeiling.rationale: Critical local PG17 role-session test; original fixture auth.uid() is always NULL, requires explicit isolated provider stub replacement and two-tenant seed proof before any RLS claim. No hosted real JWT authority.

acceptanceCriteria: Run exact current `main` Git-blob-pinned 59+19 SQL via F6-U03k with original pre/postflight and COMMIT on one verified Docker postgres:17 container, refusing all external SQL selectors.
Before seeding inspect native catalog for required organization/webshop/roles/users/Office/entitlement relations, columns and constraints and record their origin without altering base schema.

Never use the original `auth.uid()=NULL` fixture as positive proof; assert current auth.uid() stub returns NULL then explicitly override it **only in Docker** to read `request.jwt.claim.sub` with a transaction-scoped role and independently assert current session uid.

Test fixture creates exactly two distinct instances with subscription_plan Alap vs Pro and nontrivial active role and Office customer/internal rows, using native constraints; fixture cleanup is automatic disposable DB, no external fixture data.

For each role/user + tenant query assert expected exact row IDs or precise counts, positive Alap support and Pro participant visibility and strict foreign-tenant, unentitled, nonparticipant and anon denial; no all-zero false green.

Keep `releaseAuthorized=false`, `hostedTouched=false`, `realSupabaseJwtProven=false`, `realProviderDataApiProven=false`, `authFixtureOverridden=true`, `sourceCount=78`; report results with labels distinguishing simulation.
Normal exact-head Quality/TS/Build/Security/Completion Truth/Lifecycle plus dedicated actual PG17 role RLS proof PASS only after true row-level positive/negative scenarios.
invariants: All original Git-pinned 78 SQL bytes and 59-source abort-before-DROP remain intact, no source path overwritten.
Provider auth shim override is confined to disposable Docker and emitted evidence states the limitation; never copied to hosted migrations.
Fixture seed does not use superuser identity for probes; PostgreSQL authenticated role and different claims must be proven per query.
Authenticated positive and denial scenarios must both be observed, not inferred from SQL text or empty relation.
Alap support remains allowed for customer threads; internal private/team chat remains Pro and participation scoped even with stale entitlement.
No client-facing service_role key or accidental role privileges granted.
forbiddenStates: All zero rows passes local role test without positive controls.
Test uses `postgres`/`BYPASSRLS` to execute permitted/denied assertions.
A locally overridden auth.uid function or fake JWT is described as a real signed-in Supabase Auth session.
A tenant B Office row appears in tenant A SELECT or internal Pro-only row visible to Alap.
A hosted Fresh Install or platform/staging project is altered or SQL guard before DROP disabled.
A seeded synthetic user claims another user solely by arbitrary client request context in production; fake claims remain local-only.

failureModes: Legacy local auth.uid always returns NULL and all tested rows invisibly disappear, giving false denial green.
Provider auth role stub ignores SET LOCAL role or uses service_role, bypassing RLS.
Fixture row inserts fail due to missing required columns/references and CI silently skips positive cases.
Two tenants share organization or role grants and cross-tenant fixtures falsely appear authorized.
Setting stale manual/trial entitlement may unlock internal chat for Alap against strict Pro plan check.
A supposed JWT sub maps to arbitrary user without user-store role; positive case fails, incorrectly blamed on core SQL.
Session state leaks between test cases if not reset transaction locally.
edgeCases: PostgreSQL policy reads under SECURITY DEFINER may bypass RLS inside helper by design, so outer SELECT must still be authenticated and verify id rows.
PostgreSQL `auth.uid()` stub override body must read `current_setting('request.jwt.claim.sub', true)` and safely parse empty strings without error.
Separate role `anon` and authenticated, owner/grantee and `SET LOCAL` scopes; invalid claimed UUID should deny.
Office unlinked tasks have NULL thread_id and require customer-support capability only, not Pro internal chat.
Support capability evaluator needs topic/mailbox keys and privacy members for internal chats; make fixture deterministic and diagnostic.
Actual Supabase `auth.jwt()` can expose stale claims, but this local simulation cannot prove token signature, refresh or revocation.

specialistReviews.finding: Fake JWT or PostgreSQL claims are not signed Supabase sessions; a local green might be misrepresented as hosted readiness.
specialistReviews.resolution: Label simulated-only, verify SET ROLE authenticated and never mark real JWT/managed Data API proven.

specialistReviews.finding: Seeded fixtures must honor original FK/trigger and entitlement lifecycle, not ad hoc fake Office tables.
specialistReviews.resolution: Run exact original source and native schema-introspection, insert into real original relations only; fail if missing.

specialistReviews.finding: Prior F6-U03k SQL compilation had dollar quoting bugs; duplicating bundle loses authority.
specialistReviews.resolution: Use canonical existing F6-U03k script, never duplicate original SQL or source verifiers.

specialistReviews.finding: RLS local proof could be approved as complete Shoperation Core or hosted release.
specialistReviews.resolution: Explicitly maintain releaseAuthorized false; #1228/#1186 open and draft PR, require real provider signed-in sessions later.

challenge.scenario: The local auth.uid shim returns NULL for all requests and every query returns zero.
challenge.finding: All-denied falsely passes without proving any legitimate user works.
challenge.resolution: Assert stub identity, override only local with verified current_setting() and require positive and negative row results.

challenge.scenario: During the actual two-tenant PG17 row-access matrix, a test query for tenant A is executed after seeding while the PostgreSQL session remains connected as the postgres owner or a BYPASSRLS-capable service role instead of SET LOCAL ROLE authenticated, so the select can see tenant B rows even if the final captured result is incorrectly filtered in application code.
challenge.finding: The evidence is an invalid proxy for authenticated RLS enforcement: table ownership and BYPASSRLS bypass row-level policies, and a query returning the expected rows under postgres does not establish the effective browser role permission boundary.
challenge.resolution: Within every test transaction assert session_user=postgres but current_user=authenticated (or anon for anonymous) and that pg_roles.rolbypassrls is false for current_user; issue SELECT against the source relation without an application-side filter, verify exact tenant IDs and row counts, and reject queries from any owner/service identity.

challenge.scenario: Two tenant instance ids are different but share underlying organization and store-member grants.
challenge.finding: Cross-tenant isolation test may accidentally create intentionally shared access.
challenge.resolution: Seed separate organizations and role bindings; query instance/org consistency before running role cases.

challenge.scenario: Migrations reassign Office column constraints and fixture silently skips failed inserts.
challenge.finding: Fake green despite not testing actual Office rows.
challenge.resolution: Postflight schema introspection, on-error-stop, mandatory 2 tenants and source rows with exact verified IDs.

challenge.scenario: Role session state persists across cases and leaks authenticated current_user or JWT sub.
challenge.resolution: Use independent BEGIN/SET LOCAL/ROLLBACK per case, verify current_user and auth.uid every time.

challenge.scenario: A tenant with a real Alap subscription is seeded with a stale manual or platform teamChat feature entitlement, and the test accidentally checks only a customer Office thread rather than an internal_private conversation with a real participant, letting an advanced feature unlock from entitlement priority alone.
challenge.finding: An internal Office team chat that should remain Pro-only may be erroneously visible under Alap if the SQL authorization predicate trusts a manually overridden feature entitlement rather than the current webshop_instances.subscription_plan='pro' authority.
challenge.resolution: Seed distinct customer and internal_private threads in the same Alap tenant with relevant participant and stale teamChat entitlement rows; assert positive customer support select and strictly zero internal private select in the authenticated role, while a second Pro tenant with a participant and enabled teamChat is a positive internal control.

challenge.scenario: GitHub Actions sets request.jwt.claim.sub in the disposable PG17 server with set_config and runs SET LOCAL ROLE authenticated, but then a green result is included in the Completion Truth as if the user authenticated through hosted Supabase Auth with a cryptographically signed and refreshed JWT.
challenge.finding: A PostgreSQL setting is a user-controllable local test stub, not a verified Supabase JWT or PostgREST request; it does not validate token signature, expiration, app_metadata, session_id, revocation, exposed schema settings or Storage authorizations.
challenge.resolution: Assert the fixture manifest `syntheticJwt=true`, original auth.uid NULL provenance and `realSupabaseJwtProven=false`; use explicit LOCAL_SIMULATED_ROLE_RLS_NOT_SUPABASE_JWT result string, require independent hosted signed-in A/B tenant and managed provider tests before any release approval.

challenge.scenario: Fixture requires replacing RLS policies to pass.
challenge.finding: Test no longer checks original 78 source behavior.
challenge.resolution: Never change original policies, helper predicates or table privilege grants; only local auth provider stub and synthetic fixture rows allowed.

operationalIntelligence.problemStatement: F6-U03m verified original 78 SQL catalog and source policy/privilege metadata only. Next step needs actual row-level allow/deny under PostgreSQL authenticated role for two synthetic tenants, Alap customer-support vs Pro internal chat, plus cross-tenant denials. Real hosted signed-in Supabase JWT/RLS remains separate BLOCKED.

Emit a strictly local role/JWT-claim simulation SQL that explicitly replaces the synthetic auth.uid/auth.jwt bootstrap routines only on the isolated Docker database and reports this divergence, never on hosted projects.

Execute PostgreSQL `SET LOCAL ROLE authenticated` and anon negative row-level SELECT checks under multiple distinct synthetic sub-claims, verify positive same-tenant Alap customer support and Pro internal thread visibility and negative cross-tenant/Alap internal/nonparticipant/anon/expired entitlements.
Fail closed on missing positive-control fixture or unexpected any denied row; never treat all-zero visibility as RLS verification, require positive and negative assertions.
Preserve evidence `LOCAL_SIMULATED_ROLE_RLS_NOT_SUPABASE_JWT`, `releaseAuthorized=false`, separate blockers for genuine Supabase Auth/App Data API, real signed-in A/B tenant JWT and storage.
Exact-head CI, source plan, targeted Docker17 proof, Truth/Lifecycle verify scoped local-only test; no claim that hosted role sessions were tested.
